purpose: Separate discovery of recurrent flower-colour biogeographic zones from independent tests of pollinator, climate, topographic and geographic-barrier concordance.

edge_mechanism_alignment.question: Within adequately replicated species, are larger colour discontinuities on fixed photo-graph edges associated with larger external ecological or geographic contrasts?
edge_mechanism_alignment.statistic: equal-species mean of within-species Spearman rho between colour-edge score and external-edge contrast
edge_mechanism_alignment.null: reuse the same 999 within-species colour permutations with geometry and external predictors fixed
edge_mechanism_alignment.multiplicity: Holm across all evaluable predictors in the fixed primary family

shared_zone_overlay.question: If a stable recurrent flower-colour field exists, does its geography align with independently frozen predictor surfaces?
shared_zone_overlay.statistic: opportunity-weighted Spearman correlation between the recurrent colour field and each external barrier/turnover surface
shared_zone_overlay.null: reuse the same 999 species-conditioned null colour fields
shared_zone_overlay.multiplicity: Holm across all evaluable predictors in the fixed primary family

primary_predictor_family.source: Global Biotic Interactions stable versioned integrated data
primary_predictor_family.role: direct but potentially sparse pollination/flower-visitation evidence
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: Jensen-Shannon turnover in locally documented pollinator taxonomic/guild composition between edge endpoints after fixed spatial smoothing
primary_predictor_family.coverage_failure: not_evaluable; never replaced by a favourable subset
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: alignment with documented pollinator interactions, not proof of pollinator-mediated selection

primary_predictor_family.source: GBIF occurrence data independent of the iNaturalist flower-photo sampling frame
guilds: Lepidoptera as a coarse flower-visitor proxy
flower-visiting bird proxy: Trochilidae + Nectariniidae + Meliphagidae
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: Jensen-Shannon turnover in effort-standardized guild composition between edge endpoints
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: stronger turnover in the broad pollinator occurrence proxy
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: pollinator-guild landscape concordance only; occurrence is not a plant-pollination interaction

primary_predictor_family.standardization: z-score each axis on the terrestrial external grid before flower-colour outcomes are opened
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: Euclidean distance between endpoint climate vectors
primary_predictor_family.secondary_decomposition: axis-specific contrasts only if the primary climate predictor is supported; Holm within the four-axis decomposition

primary_predictor_family.edge_score: predeclared composite of endpoint topographic contrast and along-edge ruggedness, with all components standardized independently of colour
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: stronger terrain discontinuity or rugged intervening terrain

primary_predictor_family.source: fixed global land-water mask acquired before colour-field inference
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: fraction of sampled great-circle edge path lying over marine water
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: stronger marine separation including island/strait gaps
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: geographic separation concordance; not proof of historical vicariance

primary_predictor_family.source: HydroRIVERS/HydroSHEDS fixed release recorded at acquisition
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: fixed major-river crossing intensity along the great-circle edge; river-size threshold must be frozen from source attributes before colour outcomes
hierarchically weighted count of fixed boundary levels crossed by the edge, with weights frozen before colour outcomes
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: stronger crossing of established terrestrial biogeographic boundaries
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: concordance with an existing biogeographic classification; these boundaries are not independent physical causes

primary_predictor_family.edge_score: fixed hierarchical mountain-system boundary crossing intensity along the edge
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: stronger crossing of mapped mountain-system boundaries

zone_extraction.per_resample_hotspot_definition: top 10 percent of evaluable field cells within each of the 200 observed resamples
zone_extraction.persistent_zone_seed: cell belongs to the per-resample top decile in at least 60 percent of observed resamples
zone_extraction.connectivity: 8-neighbour grid connectivity with longitude wrap across the international date line
zone_extraction.neutral_zone_names: Z01, Z02, ... ordered by descending integrated colour-field intensity
zone_extraction.named_geographic_interpretation: only after neutral zones are frozen

zone_annotation.zone_factor_intensity_requirement: zone opportunity-weighted predictor mean at or above the 75th percentile of that predictor over evaluable cells

secondary_pollinator_check.purpose: Compare broad GBIF guild-proxy alignment with direct GloBI interaction alignment where both are evaluable
secondary_pollinator_check.disagreement_interpretation: sampling/interaction specificity uncertainty, not automatic rejection of either layer

claim_ceiling: The strongest supported result is a stable recurrent flower-colour biogeographic zone whose colour discontinuities are statistically concordant with one or more independently frozen ecological/geographic contrast layers. This does not by itself establish causal adaptation, pollinator-mediated selection, or historical vicariance.
